_doc: Manually maintained inputs, updated roughly quarterly from World Gold Council 'Gold Demand Trends' (gold.org). IMPORTANT: while "placeholder": true is set, the signal is EXCLUDED from scoring (shown greyed on the dashboard) — set it to false only once you have entered real WGC figures. Update the numbers AND the last_updated date each quarter; the engine also drops the signal as stale when last_updated is more than ~130 days old. Fields: central_banks.recent_4q_tonnes = official-sector net purchases over the last four reported quarters; five_year_avg_annual_tonnes = average annual net purchases over the trailing five years. etf_flows.last_3m_net_tonnes = global gold-ETF net flows over the last three months (positive = inflows).

central_banks.note: PLACEHOLDER seed values — replace with the latest WGC Gold Demand Trends figures, then set placeholder to false.

etf_flows.note: PLACEHOLDER seed values — replace with the latest WGC / ETF flow figures, then set placeholder to false.
